data.one_liner: A Dio interceptor that logs formatted JSON and cUrl commands.
data.what_it_does: It logs Dio HTTP requests, responses, errors, headers, query parameters, and processing times. It also generates and prints corresponding cUrl commands for easy copying and debugging.
use_when: You are using Dio for networking and need pretty-printed JSON logs in your console
You need to quickly copy and paste HTTP requests as cUrl commands for testing
avoid_when: You need a general-purpose logger that is not tied to HTTP interceptors
strengths: Formats JSON and prints cUrl commands correctly
Supports FormData and various content types
Easy to configure as a standard Dio interceptor
weaknesses: Limited only to Dio network logging
Lacks advanced error reporting integrations like Sentry out of the box

alternatives.name: pretty_dio_logger
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is the package that inspired this one and serves the same purpose of logging Dio requests.

alternatives.name: talker
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a more comprehensive logging and debugging ecosystem with a UI.

alternatives.name: logger
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a general-purpose application logger rather than specifically an HTTP interceptor.
